text: 创业板指涨超1%，沪指跌0.03%，深成指涨0.33%，科创50涨近2.8%，半导体芯片、算力硬件、创新药等方向涨幅居前，沪深京三市上涨个股近3100只
text_en: ChiNext Index rises over 1%, Shanghai Composite falls 0.03%, Shenzhen Component rises 0.33%, STAR 50 rises nearly 2.8%; semiconductor chips, computing power hardware, innovative drugs and other sectors lead gains, with nearly 3,100 stocks advancing across the Shanghai, Shenzhen and Beijing markets
